entries.en: The researchers investigated an antitumoral effect without claiming that the extract would benefit patients.
entries.zh: 研究人员考察了一种抗肿瘤作用，但没有声称该提取物能让患者获益。

entries.en: The study asked whether the observed changes were antitumorigenic rather than merely toxic to the cultured cells.
entries.zh: 该研究考察所观察到的变化是否具有抗肿瘤发生作用，而不只是对培养细胞有毒。

entries.en: The museum catalogue grouped antitussin with the other ointments in the physician's kit.
entries.zh: 馆藏目录把那位医生药箱里的二氟联苯膏与其他药膏归为一组。

entries.en: The review distinguished an antitussive effect from an improvement in the illness causing the cough.
entries.zh: 那篇综述区分了镇咳作用与引起咳嗽的疾病得到改善这两件事。

entries.en: The laboratory compared antityrosinase activity across the extracts before drawing any conclusions about their other effects.
entries.zh: 实验室比较了各提取物的抗酪氨酸酶活性，然后才对它们的其他作用下结论。

entries.en: The investigators asked whether the extract had any antiuratic activity, rather than assuming that it did.
entries.zh: 研究人员考察该提取物是否具有抗尿酸盐活性，而没有直接假定它具有这种活性。

entries.en: The report discussed antiurease activity without treating it as proof that the infection had cleared.
entries.zh: 报告讨论了抗尿素酶活性，但没有把它当作感染已经清除的证据。

entries.en: The pamphlet defended antivaccination, while a contemporary reply argued in favour of vaccination.
entries.zh: 小册子为反对接种辩护，而一份同时代的回应则支持接种。

entries.en: The hospital checked its antivenom inventory before the remote clinic opened for the season.
entries.zh: 偏远诊所开始本季接诊前，医院检查了抗蛇毒素的库存。

entries.en: The historical advertisement promoted an antivermicular preparation without explaining what evidence supported the claim.
entries.zh: 那则历史广告宣传了一种驱蠕虫制剂，却没有解释其说法有何证据支持。

entries.en: The trial compared an antivirotic with a placebo, but the report withheld any claim of benefit.
entries.zh: 该试验比较了一种抗病毒剂与安慰剂，但报告没有提出任何获益主张。

entries.en: The authors discussed a possible antivirulent effect without calling the organism harmless.
entries.zh: 作者讨论了一种可能的抗毒力作用，并没有说该微生物无害。

entries.en: A trace of the antivitamer remained in the extract, so the team repeated the vitamin assay.
entries.zh: 提取物中仍残留微量抗同效维生素，因此团队重复了维生素测定。

entries.en: An antivivisectionist challenged the speaker to explain why the proposed experiment required living animals.
entries.zh: 一名反对活体解剖者要求演讲者解释，为什么拟议的实验需要使用活体动物。

entries.en: The historical paper described an antixerophthalmic factor but did not establish the patient's diagnosis.
entries.zh: 那篇历史论文描述了一种抗干眼病因子，但并没有确立那名患者的诊断。

entries.en: The team investigated an antixerotic effect, keeping the tissue observations separate from claims about treatment.
entries.zh: 团队考察了一种抗干燥症作用，将组织观察与有关治疗的主张分开处理。

entries.en: The old case narrative described his antlophobia without suggesting that everyone who feared floods had a disorder.
entries.zh: 那篇旧病例叙事描述了他的洪水恐怖，但没有暗示所有害怕洪水的人都有疾病。

entries.en: The sketch marked the antocular region with a dotted outline rather than a solid boundary.
entries.zh: 草图用虚线轮廓而不是实线边界标出了眼前区。

entries.en: The old catalogue advertised an antodontalgic mixture without identifying its ingredients.
entries.zh: 那本旧目录宣传了一种止牙痛合剂，却没有列明其成分。

entries.en: The chemist compared the antodyne chromatogram with the reference record before accepting the sample's identity.
entries.zh: 化学研究人员把苯氧丙二醇的色谱图与参照记录比较，然后才接受对样品身份的判定。

entries.meaningZh: 安东内斯库〔罗马尼亚历史人物〕
entries.en: The historian compared Antonescu's speeches with the decisions recorded in the cabinet minutes.
entries.zh: 历史学者把安东内斯库的演讲与内阁会议记录中的决定作了比较。

entries.en: The illustration distinguished the antorbital area from the structures behind the eye socket.
entries.zh: 插图区分了眶前区与眼眶后方的结构。

entries.en: The diagram showed the antra from different angles, allowing the students to compare their outlines.
entries.zh: 示意图从不同角度展示这些窦腔，让学生比较它们的轮廓。

entries.en: The laboratory postponed the comparison when the antrafenine reference sample could not be found.
entries.zh: 找不到安曲非宁参照样品时，实验室推迟了比较工作。

entries.en: The consent form mentioned antrectomy, but the patient wanted the anatomical site explained before signing.
entries.zh: 同意书提到了窦切除术，但患者希望在签字前得到有关解剖部位的解释。

entries.en: The collection drawer contained Antricola specimens from an earlier cave survey.
entries.zh: 收藏抽屉里有先前一次洞穴调查取得的蝙蝠壁虱属标本。

entries.en: The referral letter mentioned antritis without specifying which antrum was involved.
entries.zh: 转诊信提到了窦炎，却没有说明涉及哪个窦腔。

entries.en: The discharge summary mentioned antroduodenectomy, while the patient's account focused on the long hospital stay.
entries.zh: 出院摘要提到了胃窦十二指肠切除术，而患者的叙述着重于漫长的住院经历。

entries.en: The supplier sent an Antron sample, and we compared it with the carpet already in the room.
entries.zh: 供应商送来一份安特纶样品，我们把它与房间里现有的地毯作比较。

entries.en: The antronasal structures were drawn on a separate sheet so that the larger diagram remained readable.
entries.zh: 鼻上颌窦结构被画在单独一张纸上，使较大的示意图仍然清晰可读。

entries.en: The student traced the antropyloric region on the diagram before comparing it with the specimen.
entries.zh: 学生先在图上描出胃窦与幽门区，再将其与标本比较。

entries.en: The curator displayed the antroscope beside its carrying case, not as equipment ready for clinical use.
entries.zh: 馆员将上颌窦镜与其携带箱一同展出，而不是把它作为可供临床使用的设备。

entries.en: The appointment letter referred to antroscopy but gave no explanation of why the examination had been requested.
entries.zh: 预约信提到了上颌窦镜检查，却没有解释为什么要求做这项检查。

entries.en: The follow-up notes described the hospital visit after antrostomy without giving instructions for performing the operation.
entries.zh: 随访记录描述了窦造口术后的就医情况，并未给出实施手术的操作说明。

entries.en: The antrotome in the museum case had a damaged handle and a partly illegible maker's mark.
entries.zh: 博物馆展柜里的窦刀柄部受损，制造商标记也有一部分难以辨认。

entries.en: The old surgical register listed antrotomy but left the patient's later progress unrecorded.
entries.zh: 旧手术登记册记载了窦切开术，却没有记录患者后来的情况。

entries.en: The researcher compared antrotonia across the recorded observations without assuming that every difference was meaningful.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了各次记录中的幽门窦张力，没有假定每一处差异都有意义。

entries.en: The antrotympanic region was shaded on the teaching diagram, while the surrounding structures were left uncoloured.
entries.zh: 教学图中的鼓窦鼓室区涂有阴影，周围结构则没有着色。

entries.en: The letter mentioned antrotympanitis, but the receiving clinic still requested the complete examination record.
entries.zh: 信中提到了鼓窦鼓室炎，但接诊诊所仍要求提供完整的检查记录。

entries.en: The student placed the Antrozous specimens in a separate drawer before checking their collection labels.
entries.zh: 学生先把洞蝠属标本放进单独的抽屉，再核对它们的采集标签。

entries.en: The patient asked whether the earlier record of antrumectomy referred to the same operation as the new summary.
entries.zh: 患者询问，早先记录中的窦切除术是否指新摘要中提到的同一次手术。

entries.en: The museum removed the ANTU container from public display and retained only a photograph.
entries.zh: 博物馆将安妥容器撤出公开展览，只保留了一张照片。

entries.en: The historical diagram separated antuitary tissue from the other regions shown on the same sheet.
entries.zh: 那幅历史示意图把垂体前叶组织与同一张纸上所示的其他区域区分开来。

entries.en: The archivist matched the antuitrin entry in the dispensary register to the receipt preserved beside it.
entries.zh: 档案管理员把药房登记册中的垂体前叶膏条目与保存在旁边的收据对应起来。

entries.meaningZh: 促生长的垂体前叶提取制剂〔旧成药名〕
entries.en: The old stock book listed antuitrin-growth separately, but the surviving page did not identify its manufacturer.
entries.zh: 旧库存账簿单独列出了促生长的垂体前叶提取制剂，但现存页面没有标明其制造商。

entries.en: Antung requested a clearer drawing before sending the revised quotation.
entries.zh: 安东公司要求先提供一份更清晰的图纸，然后才寄送修改后的报价。

entries.en: The pharmacist checked the Anturane receipt against the old dispensary register.
entries.zh: 药剂师把苯磺唑酮收据与旧药房登记册进行了核对。

entries.en: The museum arranged its Anura specimens beside the comparative drawings used in the lecture.
entries.zh: 博物馆把无尾类标本摆放在讲座所用的比较图旁边。

entries.en: The referral mentioned anusitis, but the clinician asked for the original findings rather than relying on the label alone.
entries.zh: 转诊资料提到了肛门炎，但临床医生要求查看原始检查发现，而不是只凭这个名称作判断。

entries.en: After a delayed journey, we reached Anyang just in time for our meeting.
entries.zh: 行程受到耽搁后，我们抵达安养，刚好赶上会面。

entries.en: The parcel reached Anyuan after its address had been corrected at the sorting office.
entries.zh: 分拣处更正地址后，那件包裹抵达了安源。

entries.en: An ANZAC in the photograph stood beside a battered field kitchen.
entries.zh: 照片里，一名澳新军团士兵站在一个破旧的野战厨房旁。

entries.en: The archive kept the ANZAM correspondence apart from later defence agreements.
entries.zh: 档案馆将澳新马往来函件与后来的防务协定分开保存。

entries.en: The archive's ANZUK folder contained a faded photograph and an unsigned letter.
entries.zh: 档案馆的澳新英文件夹内，有一张褪色照片和一封未署名的信。

entries.en: The student compared the ANZUS treaty text with the summary used in class.
entries.zh: 学生把澳新美条约原文与课堂使用的摘要作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 大气和海洋信息处理系统
entries.en: The researchers used AOIPS to compare the satellite images before preparing the conference display.
entries.zh: 研究人员利用大气和海洋信息处理系统比较卫星图像，然后才准备会议展示材料。

entries.en: We reached Aomen after sunset and left our luggage at the hotel before looking for dinner.
entries.zh: 我们日落后抵达澳门，先把行李放在酒店，再去找晚餐。

entries.meaningZh: 美国手术室护士协会〔历史名称〕
entries.en: The nurse took the draft agenda to the AORN meeting and asked for comments.
entries.zh: 那名护士把议程草稿带到美国手术室护士协会的会议上征求意见。

entries.en: The students compared the preserved aortae without assuming that differences in shape revealed their causes.
entries.zh: 学生比较了保存下来的主动脉标本，没有假定形状上的差异能揭示其成因。

entries.en: The old letter described aortalgia but contained no account of how the complaint had been assessed.
entries.zh: 那封旧信描述了主动脉痛，却没有说明这种主诉是如何评估的。

entries.en: The anatomical drawing showed aortarctia without suggesting how the narrowing had developed.
entries.zh: 解剖图展示了主动脉狭窄，但没有暗示狭窄是如何形成的。

entries.en: The discussion of aortectasia relied on the earlier images, not on the patient's age alone.
entries.zh: 有关主动脉扩张的讨论依据了先前的影像，而不是只依据患者的年龄。

entries.en: The report described aortectasis in one image but left the cause unresolved.
entries.zh: 报告描述了一张影像中的主动脉扩张，但没有确定其原因。

entries.en: The patient's account of aortectomy focused on the hospital stay rather than the details of the operation.
entries.zh: 患者关于主动脉部分切除术的叙述着重于住院经历，而不是手术细节。

entries.en: The anatomy worksheet linked the aorticorenal structures with arrows, but provided no account of their function.
entries.zh: 解剖练习纸用箭头连接主动脉与肾的结构，却没有说明它们的功能。

entries.en: The old case report recorded aortoclasia, but its damaged pages left the surrounding events unclear.
entries.zh: 那份旧病例报告记录了主动脉破裂，但页面受损，使相关事件的经过不清楚。

entries.en: The physician placed the aortogram beside the earlier image and asked which features had changed.
entries.zh: 医生将主动脉造影片放在先前的影像旁，询问哪些特征发生了变化。

entries.en: The aortographic images were filed separately because their dates had been omitted from the summary.
entries.zh: 主动脉造影影像被单独归档，因为摘要中漏掉了它们的日期。

entries.en: The drawing placed the aortolith within the vessel wall rather than loose in the lumen.
entries.zh: 那幅图把主动脉石画在血管壁内，而不是画成游离在管腔中的样子。

entries.en: The pathological record mentioned aortolithia without stating whether the deposit had affected blood flow.
entries.zh: 病理记录提到了主动脉结石，却没有说明沉积物是否影响了血流。

entries.en: The historical account described aortomalacia without treating softening and rupture as the same finding.
entries.zh: 那篇历史记述描述了主动脉软化，但没有把软化与破裂视为同一种发现。

entries.en: The letter referred to aortopathy but did not name a specific disorder.
entries.zh: 信中提到了主动脉病，却没有列出具体疾病名称。

entries.en: The old diagram illustrated aortoptosia with the vessel drawn lower than in the comparison figure.
entries.zh: 旧示意图把血管画得比对照图中的位置更低，以展示腹主动脉下垂。

entries.en: The surgeon's summary mentioned aortorrhaphy but left the timing of the suturing unclear.
entries.zh: 外科医生的摘要提到了主动脉缝合术，却没有说明缝合的具体时间。

entries.en: The old description of aortosclerosis concerned the aortic wall, not the valve alone.
entries.zh: 那段对主动脉硬化的旧描述涉及主动脉壁，而不只是瓣膜。

entries.en: The report described aortostenosis but did not say whether the narrowing had changed since the earlier examination.
entries.zh: 报告描述了主动脉狭窄，却没有说明狭窄与先前检查时相比是否发生了变化。

entries.en: The operative summary mentioned aortotomy without including the detailed sequence of the procedure.
entries.zh: 手术摘要提到了主动脉切开术，但没有包含手术的详细步骤。

entries.en: The novelist Aosta left the revised manuscript at reception and asked us to collect it before closing time.
entries.zh: 小说家奥斯塔把修改后的稿件留在接待处，请我们在关门前取走。

entries.en: The therapist brought the draft proposal to the AOTA meeting and listened to the questions it raised.
entries.zh: 治疗师把提案草稿带到美国职业疗法协会的会议上，并听取了由此提出的问题。

entries.meaningZh: 奥特亚罗瓦；长白云之乡
entries.en: After years abroad, she returned to Aotearoa with photographs of the places she had lived.
entries.zh: 在国外多年后，她带着曾经居住过的地方的照片回到了奥特亚罗瓦。

entries.en: The collection grouped the Aotus specimens together while keeping their individual field records separate.
entries.zh: 收藏中，夜猴属标本放在一起，各自的野外记录则分开保存。

entries.meaningZh: 抗恶性贫血因子〔历史用法〕
entries.en: The historical nutrition report discussed APAF without identifying a specific chemical preparation.
entries.zh: 那份历史营养报告讨论了抗恶性贫血因子，却没有确定某一种具体化学制剂。

entries.en: The apalcillin sample remained unclassified in the comparison because its identification record was incomplete.
entries.zh: 由于鉴定记录不完整，阿帕西林样品在此次比较中仍未归类。

entries.en: The old examination record mentioned apallesthesia without explaining which observations had supported that finding.
entries.zh: 旧检查记录提到了振动觉缺失，却没有解释哪些观察支持这一发现。

entries.en: The authors discussed apamin separately from the other compounds in the venom sample.
entries.zh: 作者将蜂毒样品中的蜂毒明肽与其他化合物分开讨论。

entries.en: The discussion considered an apancreatic origin for the findings rather than assuming that the pancreas was involved.
entries.zh: 讨论考虑了这些发现的非胰性来源，而没有直接假定胰腺参与其中。

entries.en: In the old case narrative, her apandria made conversations with male visitors distressing.
entries.zh: 在那篇旧病例叙事中，她对男性的厌恶让她觉得与男访客交谈很难受。

entries.en: The historical account described his apanthropia without treating a preference for solitude as sufficient evidence of illness.
entries.zh: 那篇历史记述描述了他对他人的厌避，并没有把喜欢独处视为患病的充分证据。

entries.en: Her apanthropy was a recurring theme in the old biography, not a diagnosis made by its editor.
entries.zh: 那本旧传记反复谈到她对他人的厌避，这不是编辑作出的诊断。

entries.en: The historical case summary mentioned aparathyreosis but left the reason for the loss of function unresolved.
entries.zh: 历史病例摘要提到了甲状旁腺机能缺失，却没有确定机能丧失的原因。

entries.en: The historical chapter discussed aparathyroidism without presenting every reduction in gland function as complete absence.
entries.zh: 那一历史章节讨论了甲状旁腺机能缺失，没有把每一种腺体机能降低都当作完全缺失。

entries.en: The case summary mentioned aparathyrosis but did not state whether the gland tissue was present.
entries.zh: 病例摘要提到了甲状旁腺机能缺失，却没有说明腺体组织是否存在。

entries.en: He remained apathic throughout the argument, showing none of the anger that filled the room.
entries.zh: 争论期间，他始终表现淡漠，没有显露出房间里弥漫的那种愤怒。

entries.en: The student sketched the Apatura specimen before returning it to the museum drawer.
entries.zh: 学生画下闪蛱蝶属标本的素描，然后将它放回博物馆的抽屉。

entries.en: The laboratory questioned the apazone sample's identity when its spectrum failed to match the reference spectrum.
entries.zh: 当阿扎丙宗样品的光谱与参照光谱不一致时，实验室对其身份提出了疑问。

entries.en: The comparative anatomy drawing marked the ape-fissure with an arrow beside the other labelled grooves.
entries.zh: 比较解剖图用箭头标出猿裂，旁边还有其他标有名称的沟裂。

entries.meaningZh: 早期学习水平评价程序
entries.en: The school psychologist reviewed the APELL results before meeting the child's teacher.
entries.zh: 学校心理学者先查阅早期学习水平评价程序的结果，再与那名孩子的老师会面。

entries.en: During the seminar, we compared ancient accounts of Apelles with later legends about him.
entries.zh: 研讨课上，我们把有关阿佩利斯的古代记载与后来关于他的传说作了比较。

entries.en: High winds delayed our journey through the Apennine mountains, so we reached the village after dark.
entries.zh: 强风耽搁了我们穿越亚平宁山脉的行程，因此我们天黑后才抵达村庄。

entries.en: The old diary described a prolonged struggle with apepsia without explaining how it had been assessed.
entries.zh: 那本旧日记描述了长期受消化不良困扰的经历，却没有解释当时是如何评估这种情况的。

entries.en: The case report distinguished apepsinia from a general complaint of poor digestion.
entries.zh: 病例报告区分了胃蛋白酶缺乏与一般的消化不佳主诉。

entries.en: The drawing showed a small apertura between the adjacent structures, but did not name them.
entries.zh: 图中显示相邻结构之间有一个小孔，但没有标明这些结构的名称。

entries.en: The dentist's old apexigraph was displayed beside the cabinet that once held it.
entries.zh: 那位牙医的旧牙根尖定位器与曾经存放它的柜子一同展出。

entries.en: The dental museum borrowed an apexograph from a collection whose original inventory had survived.
entries.zh: 牙科博物馆从一个原始清单保存完好的收藏中借来了一件牙根尖定位器。

entries.en: The old ophthalmic record described the eye as aphacic, without explaining why the lens was absent.
entries.zh: 旧眼科记录称该眼无晶状体，却没有解释晶状体缺失的原因。

entries.en: The historical account described aphagopraxia without confusing an inability to swallow with a refusal to eat.
entries.zh: 那篇历史记述描述了吞咽不能，没有把无法吞咽与拒绝进食混淆。

entries.en: The geologist sketched the aphanipyric texture before comparing the drawing with another specimen's sketch.
entries.zh: 地质学者先画出隐晶基斑状结构，再将这幅图与另一件标本的素描比较。

entries.en: The laboratory stored the Aphanomyces images separately so that the collection labels could be checked later.
entries.zh: 实验室将丝囊霉属图像分开保存，以便以后核对收藏标签。

entries.en: The lecturer retained Aphasmidea on the historical chart while explaining that classifications can change.
entries.zh: 讲师在历史分类图上保留了有腺纲，同时解释分类体系可能变化。

entries.meaningZh: 无尾觉器亚纲〔历史分类名〕
entries.en: The old survey assigned the specimens to Aphasmidia, and the editor preserved that historical classification.
entries.zh: 那项旧调查把标本归入无尾觉器亚纲，编辑保留了这一历史分类。

entries.en: The catalogue grouped the Aphelenchoidea specimens together, although several collection labels were missing.
entries.zh: 尽管一些采集标签已经遗失，目录仍将滑刃总科标本归在一起。

entries.en: The interviewer offered written questions to the aphemic patient rather than assuming a failure of comprehension.
entries.zh: 访谈者向那名运动性失语患者提供书面问题，而没有直接假定其理解力存在障碍。

entries.en: The chemist checked the aphidicolin chromatogram against a reference chromatogram before approving the sample record.
entries.zh: 化学研究人员将阿非迪霉素的色谱图与参照色谱图核对，然后才认可样品记录。

entries.en: The entomologist separated the Aphididae specimens from the rest of the collection before checking the identification cards.
entries.zh: 昆虫学者先将蚜科标本与其余藏品分开，再核对鉴定卡。

entries.en: The teaching cabinet grouped the Aphidoidea specimens by their recorded collection sites rather than by colour.
entries.zh: 教学标本柜按记录的采集地点而不是颜色，对蚜总科标本进行分组。

entries.en: The old biography described his aphilanthropia through rejected invitations and increasingly hostile letters.
entries.zh: 那本旧传记通过遭拒的邀请和敌意越来越强的信件，描述他对他人的厌恶。

entries.en: The novel contrasted her aphilanthropy with the quiet shyness of the other character.
entries.zh: 小说将她对他人的厌恶与另一人物安静害羞的性格作了对比。

entries.en: The early catalogue placed these flies in Aphiochaeta, and the modern editor retained the original identification in a note.
entries.zh: 早期目录将这些蝇归入蚤蝇属，现代编辑在注释中保留了原鉴定。

entries.meaningZh: 无脉叶片〔某些蕨类的结构〕
entries.en: The illustrator drew the aphlebia separately so that it would not be hidden beneath the fern's other parts.
entries.zh: 插图绘制者将无脉叶片单独画出，以免它被蕨类植物的其他部分遮住。

entries.en: She remained aphonous during the interview and wrote her replies instead of trying to force a sound.
entries.zh: 访谈期间，她仍无法发声，便写下回答，而没有试图勉强发声。

entries.en: His account of aphony described the frustration of being unable to call to someone across the room.
entries.zh: 他关于失声的叙述描述了无法呼喊房间另一头的人时那种挫败感。

entries.en: The old record mentioned aphotesthesia but supplied no measurements of the patient's light perception.
entries.zh: 旧记录提到视网膜光感减退，却没有提供该患者光感的测量数据。

entries.en: During the observation, the aphototropic animals moved away from the illuminated end of the container.
entries.zh: 观察期间，这些反趋光动物从容器受光的一端移开。

entries.en: The laboratory set aside the aphoxide sample when its identification record proved incomplete.
entries.zh: 实验室发现鉴定记录不完整后，将三乙撑磷酰胺样品暂时搁置。

entries.en: The researcher compared the aphrodescin chromatogram with the archived record rather than relying on the handwritten sample label.
entries.zh: 研究人员把马栗甙的色谱图与存档记录比较，而不是只凭手写样品标签作判断。

entries.en: The marine collection kept the Aphroditidae specimens beside drawings of their external features.
entries.zh: 海洋生物藏品中，鳞沙蚕科标本旁放着描绘其外部特征的图。

entries.en: The naturalist photographed the Aphrophora specimen before returning the branch to its original position.
entries.zh: 博物学者拍下尖胸沫蝉属标本的照片，然后将树枝放回原位。

entries.meaningZh: 管壁石杯纲〔历史分类名〕
entries.en: The curator kept Aphrosalpingidea separate on the historical classification chart.
entries.zh: 馆员在历史分类图上把管壁石杯纲单独列出。

entries.en: An aphtha on the inside of her cheek was visible in the dental photograph.
entries.zh: 牙科照片里能看到她面颊内侧的一处口疮。

entries.en: The teaching photographs showed aphthae without claiming that their appearance alone established a cause.
entries.zh: 教学照片展示了口疮，但没有声称单凭外观就能确定病因。

entries.en: The museum moved the aphthitalite specimen to a new drawer after its label was repaired.
entries.zh: 标签修复后，博物馆将钾芒硝标本移到了一个新抽屉。

entries.en: The case report distinguished aphthongia from a simple reluctance to speak.
entries.zh: 病例报告区分了痉挛性失语与单纯不愿说话。

entries.en: The dental photograph showed an aphthous ulcer on the inside of the lower lip.
entries.zh: 牙科照片显示下唇内侧有一处口疮性溃疡。

entries.meaningZh: 阿夫蒂特铁镍四元合金
entries.en: The old specification required Aphtit rather than the alloy in the supplier's sample.
entries.zh: 旧规格书要求使用阿夫蒂特铁镍四元合金，而不是供应商样品中的那种合金。

entries.en: The historical report contrasted an aphylactic patient with one whose defences remained intact.
entries.zh: 那份历史报告将一名毫无防御力的患者与一名防御功能完好的患者作了对比。

entries.en: The old botanical chart kept Aphyllanthaceae separate from the neighbouring families.
entries.zh: 旧植物分类图把星捧月科与旁边的科分开列出。

entries.en: The botanist compared the Aphyllanthes specimens with the drawings preserved in the field notebook.
entries.zh: 植物学者把无叶花属标本与野外笔记中保存的图比较。

entries.en: The chemist set aside the aphyllidine reference solution when its identity became uncertain.
entries.zh: 当无叶毒藜碱参照溶液的身份变得不确定时，化学研究人员将它暂时搁置。

entries.en: The team checked the aphylline peak against a reference chromatogram before naming the other compound.
entries.zh: 团队将无叶假木贼碱的峰与参照色谱图核对，然后才为另一种化合物确定名称。

entries.en: The old fungal collection still grouped those specimens under Aphyllophorales.
entries.zh: 那个旧真菌收藏仍将那些标本归在多孔菌目之下。

entries.en: The drawing emphasized the plant's aphylly without suggesting that its leaves had been torn off.
entries.zh: 图画突出了该植物的无叶性，但没有暗示它的叶片是被扯掉的。

entries.en: The student sorted the Apiaceae specimens before rearranging the rest of the herbarium.
entries.zh: 学生先整理伞形科标本，再重新安排植物标本室的其余藏品。

entries.en: The botanist compared the apiaceous specimens before deciding which belonged in the display.
entries.zh: 植物学者比较了这些伞形科标本，然后才决定哪些应当放入展览。

entries.en: The dental consent form mentioned apicectomy, but the patient requested an explanation before signing it.
entries.zh: 牙科同意书提到了根尖切除术，但患者要求在签字前得到解释。
